prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a checklist layout summarizing what to expect during pet setup.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "checklist"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Reconnect Safety Hint: Display a hint on sign-in clarifying that logging into an existing account safely recovers previously created pets and settings.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Logging into your existing account instantly restores your saved pets and progress."}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Screen: Move the sign-in step to immediately after selecting a companion on the pick_friend screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_screen] New Companion Name Confirmation Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after pick_friend where users enter and confirm their pet's name.
   config: {"new_pet_name_confirmation_screen": {"headline": "Name Your New Pet Companion", "body": "Give your desktop friend a unique name before generating their profile.", "button_label": "Save Name"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_name_confirmation_screen", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Screen Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the Pick Friend companion selection screen to use a side-by-side two-column layout.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column"}}
5: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint: Add a reassurance hint to the adoption certificate screen confirming desktop pet settings are saved.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Your desktop companion setup is complete and securely registered."}}
6: [adoption, new_flow] New Companion Mood Preview Screen: Add a short companion mood selection screen after adoption certificate to preview how the pet reacts on desktop.
   config: {"new_companion_mood_preview": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet's Initial Mood", "body": "Select how your pet greets you when appearing on your desktop.", "button_label": "Set Mood"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_companion_mood_preview", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Tray Loading Hint: Display a background hint on the waiting screen explaining that the pet launches into the system tray when ready.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your pet is initializing and will appear in your system tray upon completion."}}
8: [finish, notification] Home Intro Companion Tray Icon Prompt: Enable background system notification on the home intro screen directing users to the taskbar tray icon.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Look for your pet's companion icon in the system tray to control visibility anytime.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Screen Centered Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen layout to a centered focus presentation with primary action buttons.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered"}}

verdicts.reason: The story screen's job is to introduce the pet, which is lost when converted to a setup checklist.
Adding a sign-in account recovery hint is valid and follows all base rules.
Reordering sign-in after pick_friend is explicitly allowed within onboarding.
Adding a pet naming confirmation screen during onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning pick_friend to a two-column layout preserves its core job.
Adding a setup reassurance hint to the adoption certificate screen is compliant.
Inserting a companion mood preview screen in onboarding is allowed.
Adding an informative system tray hint on the waiting screen is compliant.
Adding system tray notifications to home_intro is permitted inside onboarding.
Redesigning the home_intro screen to a centered layout is allowed.
